title: Gravity
description:
[h2]Cut loose and hang low.[/h2]
Climbing the Spire sounds like work. Gravity lets the map come to you: paths disappear and encounters tumble into a big, friendly pile.

Visit the starting Ancient, then pick whatever encounters you fancy, in whatever order you like. The boss unlocks after 15 encounters. Go say hello, or keep rummaging through the pile. No rush.

[h2]Your pile, your rules[/h2]
[list]
[*]Change how many encounters unlock the boss: 15, a custom number, or absolutely all of them.
[*]Disable the requirement and visit as many (or as few) encounters as you like before the boss.
[*]Enable encounter limits to close the buffet once you've hit your chosen count.
[*]Pick a highlight color for your boss rings and turn the encounter pulse up, down, or off.
[*]Eat bagels or chips. Not a setting. Just a serving suggestion.
[/list]

Find run settings under [b]Mods → Gravity[/b]. During a run, click the stairs icon or encounter count to adjust the look. Boss rings and the counter keep track while you make questionable decisions.

[h2]Bring friends. Bring snacks.[/h2]
Start a fresh run with Gravity enabled. In co-op, everyone needs the same version and the host picks the rules. Other mods that change map travel or show routes may get tangled in the pile.
